item: 4.8 "don't ask again" destination — the Always-allow button is a SPLIT: the main half keeps the CLI's own destination, the caret lists the other places the rule can live (2026-09-04)
branch: permSuggestions keeps each grant's own `destination` (the CLI sends localSettings on every measured rule card); renderPermission wraps a grant that HAS a destination in the split idiom even when it holds a single rule, and the popup lists every other destination as a `.popup-item.dest[data-d]` row (after the per-rule rows and a header on a compound card). Picking one answers with the whole grant plus `dest`, which rides the bridge `perm` message and Kotlin stamps onto every non-setMode echoed entry. setMode grants (accept-all-edits) carry no destination and get no rows.
provenance: Frame shapes are the CLI's (`permission_suggestions` on can_use_tool → the panel's `suggestions` string; docs/ide-mcp-protocol.md). The destination set is VS Code 2.1.260's cycle (`webview/index.js` Ss=[localSettings,userSettings,projectSettings,session]; cliArg never offered). Every value was MEASURED honoured on 2.1.260 (2026-09-04, stdio probe in a trusted scratch workspace): an echoed `destination` that differs from the suggestion's own is what decides the file — projectSettings → .claude/settings.json, localSettings → .claude/settings.local.json, userSettings → <config dir>/settings.json, session → nothing on disk and no re-ask in the same session; an UNKNOWN value drops the grant silently (re-asks next turn). Negative control on the pre-4.8 build: a single-rule grant renders a plain button (no .split), no `.dest` rows exist anywhere, and the tape's perm message carries no `dest` — those asserts are DISCRIMINATING; the compound card's per-rule rows and the setMode card's lack of rows are GUARDS.

steps.note: single-rule grant: the split appears with the three other destinations, the main half keeps the default
steps.setup: window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({type:'__clear'})); if (!window.__realBridge77) { window.__realBridge77 = window.__bridge; } window.__tape77 = []; window.__bridge = function(j){ window.__tape77.push(JSON.parse(j)); };

expect.why: DISCRIMINATING: a single-rule grant is a split button now (pre-fix: a plain .alt, no .split)

expect.js: (function(){ var b = document.querySelector('#log .card-b .split .alt:not(.more)'); return b ? b.title.indexOf('settings.local.json') >= 0 : 'absent'; })()
expect.why: DISCRIMINATING (pre-fix: no split, so absent): the main half still names the CLI's own destination — the default is unchanged
DISCRIMINATING: the caret lists every destination EXCEPT the grant's own, session first (pre-fix: no rows)

expect.js: (function(){ var r = document.querySelector('#log .card-menu .popup-item.dest[data-d="session"]'); if (!r) return 'absent'; r.click(); var m = window.__tape77[window.__tape77.length-1]; return m ? [m.kind, m.id, m.allow, m.sugg, m.dest].join('|') : 'no-msg'; })()
expect.why: DISCRIMINATING: picking a destination answers with the WHOLE grant (sugg 0) plus dest=session (pre-fix: no row to click)
